# SendEmAll

> The all-in-one B2B outbound platform. Find buyers with verified emails, send from warmed mailboxes, and follow up on email and LinkedIn in one sequence. Use the full stack — or just the piece your outbound is missing.

## Key Information

- SendEmAll finds B2B leads three ways: a 66M+ contact / 10M+ company data lake, scraping the customer's own Apollo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator account (their seat, on a dedicated residential IP), and Google Maps public listings. Every email is verified before delivery.
- Billing anchor: credits buy data. 1 credit = 1 verified, valid email delivered. Catch-all, invalid, and risky results are labeled and free. Buying signals and enrichments (Google/Meta ads detection, tech-stack detection, LinkedIn Open Profile checks) also use credits, at rates shown in the app. Sending never uses credits — it is a flat subscription.
- The sequencer is $99/mo with unlimited seats, workspaces, email sending, warmup, and reply management. It also runs LinkedIn outreach: connection requests, messages, and InMail as steps inside the same sequence as email; a reply on either channel stops both. Every plan includes 1 LinkedIn sending account on its own dedicated residential IP; extra LinkedIn accounts are $39/mo each.
- Risk reversal: under 3% bounce on the leads SendEmAll provides, or the first month is refunded (applies to leads SendEmAll provided, first month only).
- No lock-in: push leads and mailboxes to Instantly or PlusVibe free of charge, export CSV for any other tool, or use SendEmAll's own sequencer.
- Sending infrastructure is self-serve: Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 mailboxes at $3.50/mo each, SMTP at $1.50/mo, and Azure shared tenants at $40/mo carrying 100 mailboxes on one domain. SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and warmup are automated; domains at live registrar cost, pre-aged inventory available, or bring your own. A 5% platform fee applies at checkout.
- Safe sending limits: up to 30 cold + 30 warmup emails/day per Google/Microsoft mailbox, 50 + 50 per SMTP mailbox, 500 + 500 per Azure tenant; up to 5 mailboxes recommended per domain.
- Every new account starts with 500 free credits, no card required. In-app chat support on every plan.

## Pricing

- Starter: $59/mo — 25,000 credits per month (verified emails, signals & enrichments)
- Growth: $79/mo — 50,000 credits per month, the best rate at $1.58 per 1,000 valid emails
- Sequencer: $99/mo — unlimited seats, workspaces, email sending, warmup, and reply management; 1 LinkedIn account included, extra LinkedIn accounts $39/mo each
- Infrastructure: SMTP mailboxes $1.50/mo, Google Workspace & Microsoft 365 $3.50/mo, Azure shared tenant $40/mo (100 mailboxes); domains at registrar cost

## Capabilities

- Leads: search 66M+ B2B contacts and 10M+ companies, scrape your own Apollo / Sales Navigator / Google Maps, describe your ICP in plain English, filter by buying signals, verify every email — pay only for valid results
- Sequencer: multi-step email + LinkedIn sequences, A/B testing, sending schedules, unified inbox, warmup, positive-reply detection — unlimited seats and workspaces at one flat price
- LinkedIn outreach: connection requests, messages, and InMail from the customer's own LinkedIn account, on a dedicated residential IP, at a safe human pace (ramp to 40 actions/day, hard ceiling 50); Sales Navigator is only needed for the InMail path, never as a blanket requirement
- Infrastructure: self-serve Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Azure, and SMTP mailboxes with DNS configured, warmup built in, pre-warmed inventory, and deliverability monitoring
- Developer access: REST API, MCP server, webhooks, CSV import/export, CLI (beta)
